adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds SQL with direct string interpolation: `execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ... )"`. Nothing escapes quotes or other characters in `h` (which comes from the legacy `site_settings` value split by newlines). If any legacy line contains a `'` or other SQL-significant characters, the INSERT can raise a SQL syntax error and abort the entire migration (no rescue/transaction handling shown). This is a concrete, diff-verifiable correctness/robustness defect in the migration.
